# Rōmy

> Rōmy helps small nonprofits find new major donors at a fraction of the cost of existing solutions.

Rōmy is a donor intelligence platform built for small nonprofit teams. It uses AI-powered prospect research to surface wealth indicators, giving histories, and affinity signals — then distills them into actionable 16-section donor profiles. Purpose-built for development offices that can't afford enterprise tools like DonorSearch, iWave, or WealthEngine.

## What Rōmy Does

Rōmy is a prospect research tool that replaces expensive enterprise wealth screening. It researches individual donors and generates a full intelligence report covering capacity, inclination, connections, and recommended outreach strategy. Each report typically takes 2–10 minutes and costs $0.50–$5, compared to $8–$15 per report from enterprise tools.

On PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark), Rōmy scored 94.6 vs. Claude 92.2, ChatGPT 79.9, and Gemini 76.0 — the highest accuracy score among all tested systems.

## Key Features

- **AI-powered donor prospect research** — wealth indicators, giving history, affinity signals
- **16-section donor profiles** — more comprehensive than enterprise tools (5–8 sections)
- **No enterprise contracts** — starting at $290/year, vs. $15,000–$50,000/year for enterprise
- **2–10 minute turnaround** per full report (vs. 45 minutes of manual research)
- **Fraction of the cost** — $0.50–$5 per report vs. $8–$50 with enterprise or manual methods
- **Quiet wealth detection** — surfaces donors traditional wealth screens miss

## Pricing

- **Growth Plan**: $290/year
- **Scale Plan**: $1,990/year
- **Enterprise**: Contact for pricing

## Who Rōmy Is For

Small nonprofit development offices (budgets under $2M) that need major donor prospect research but cannot afford DonorSearch, iWave, WealthEngine, or similar enterprise platforms. Rōmy gives small shops the same intelligence advantage as large institutions at a price built for lean teams.

## Blog Posts

Rōmy publishes expert writing on nonprofit fundraising strategy, donor psychology, major gift fundraising, prospect research, and AI donor intelligence.

### Field Notes

- [Capacity Scores Are the Astrology of Fundraising](/blog/capacity-scores-are-the-astrology-of-fundraising) (2026-06-01): A capacity score is a four-digit number that promises — with quiet algorithmic confidence — to tell you what a stranger will give you over the next ten years. It is the most expensive horoscope in fundraising.
- [Earn the Second Meeting](/blog/earn-the-second-meeting) (2026-05-11): The goal of the first donor meeting is the second one. A short letter on the coffee that doesn't close anything, the brochure that should stay in the bag, and the one question that quietly turns a polite stranger into a lifetime giver.
- [Her First Ask](/blog/her-first-ask) (2026-05-10): Most of the people doing major-gift work in small shops are twenty-four years old, terrified, and quietly carrying the entire program. A short letter on the asymmetry across the table — and the file that closes it.

### Research & Benchmarks (Rōmy Labs)

- [PIF-Bench: Benchmarking AI Donor Research — Rōmy vs. ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini](/labs/blog/benchmarking-ai-prospect-research) (2026-04-25): We built a ground-truth benchmark and ran it head-to-head. Rōmy scored 94.6, Claude 92.2, ChatGPT 79.9, Gemini 76.0. Full methodology and results.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is Rōmy?**
Rōmy is an AI-powered donor intelligence platform for small nonprofits. It researches individual prospects and produces 16-section donor intelligence reports covering wealth indicators, giving history, connections, and recommended outreach strategy.

**How does Rōmy compare to DonorSearch, iWave, or WealthEngine?**
Rōmy costs $290–$1,990/year vs. $15,000–$50,000/year for enterprise platforms. On PIF-Bench, Rōmy scored 94.6 — outperforming generic AI tools and matching or exceeding the accuracy of enterprise systems at a fraction of the price.

**What is PIF-Bench?**
PIF-Bench (Prospect Intelligence Fidelity Benchmark) is Rōmy's open benchmark for measuring the accuracy, depth, cost, and speed of AI-powered donor prospect research. It compares Rōmy, ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini across multiple dimensions using standardized prompts evaluated by Claude Opus.

**How much does a Rōmy donor research report cost?**
$0.50–$5 per full report on the Growth and Scale plans. Enterprise tools charge $8–$15 per report.

**How long does a Rōmy prospect report take?**
2–10 minutes for a full 16-section donor intelligence report, versus ~45 minutes for manual research.

**Who is Rōmy for?**
Small nonprofit development offices — typically organizations with budgets under $2M — that need professional-grade prospect research but cannot afford enterprise wealth screening contracts.
